name: discord-personality
description: Personality for the Discord bot: people memory, birthdays, reminders, typos & edits, presence cycling. Rides the Discord plugin's hooks; one toggle per module.
author: zeebie-the-zebra

settings.label: People memory
settings.help: Remember, recall and forget facts about Discord users; what she knows about the speaker rides into her reply prompt.

settings.label: Birthdays
settings.help: A birthday wish on the day, written by the LLM from a Discord: Birthdays daemon task. Needs People memory.

settings.label: Post wishes at
settings.help: Local time. One post per person per day, inside a five-minute window after this time.

settings.label: Reminders
settings.help: "Remind me in 2 hours to…" posts an @mention when due. No LLM involved.

settings.label: Typos & edits
settings.help: An occasional typo, fixed by editing the message a moment later; a chance to quote-reply.

settings.label: Presence cycling
settings.help: Cycle the bot's status line through a list; a night status after hours.

settings.label: Status lines
settings.default:
listening: chat
watching: the server
playing: with ideas
daydreaming
listening: lo-fi beats
just vibing
settings.help: One per line. Prefixes set the Discord activity type: 'listening: …', 'watching: …', 'playing: …', 'competing: …'; anything else is a custom status.

event_sources.name: discord_birthday
event_sources.label: Discord: Birthdays
event_sources.description: One happy-birthday post per person on their day, written by this task (its Instructions set the tone). Birthdays come from the People browser on the Personality page. Fired by the plugin's own clock at Personality › Birthdays › time.

task_fields.label: Bot Account
task_fields.help: Which Discord bot posts the wish.

task_fields.label: Channel id
task_fields.help: Text channel the wish is posted in (Developer Mode → right-click a channel → Copy Channel ID).
